title: psephellus leptophyllus
intro: Psephellus leptophyllus, commonly known as the needle-leaf scabious, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). The plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. Psephellus leptophyllus has been reported to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties.
